description: Figure 7 is a line plot that shows the evolution of KV caches in the streaming setting. The x-axis represents the number of tokens, and the y-axis represents the time in seconds. The plot shows that as the number of tokens increases, the time also increases. The plot also shows that the time increases at a faster rate for larger models.
